narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>A billion has nine zeros, so nine digits are enough.
<bookmark mark='cmp'/>Nine digits give only one billion codes, and we need eight and a half billion.
<bookmark mark='strike'/>Most packets would have no code, so nine digits fall short.
